233:   unsigned int i;
234: 
235:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
236:     {
237:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_FREE)
238:         {
239:           count++;
240:         }
241:     }
242: 
243:   return count;
244: }

261: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
262:                      uint32_t *order)
263: {
264:   uint32_t wire[2];
265:   int ret;
266: 
267:   *order = ++g_send_order;
268:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
269:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
270:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
271:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
272:   if (ret == OK)
273:     {
274:       g_stats.tx++;
275:     }
276:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
277:     {
278:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
279:     }
280: 
281:   if (ret < 0)
282:     {
283:       g_stats.last_tx_error = (uint32_t)(-ret);
284:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3,
285:         (g_stats.last_tx_error & 0xffu) |
286:         ((g_stats.timeout & 0xffu) << 8) |
287:         ((g_stats.fifo_full & 0xffu) << 16) |
288:         ((g_stats.ack_overflow & 0xffu) << 24));
289:     }
290: 
291:   return ret;
292: }

300:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_SENT &&
301:           g_ack_slots[i].order < order)
302:         {
303:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;

305:     }

329: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
330:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
331:                                  int result)
332: {
333:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
334: 
335:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
336:     {
337:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
338:       channel->queued = false;
339:       channel->result = result;
340:     }
341: 
342:   active->busy = false;
343:   if (result == OK)
344:     {
345:       release_acks_before(active->order);
346:     }
347: 
348:   if (active->callback != NULL)
349:     {
350:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
351:     }
352: }

374: static void release_recovery_slots(void)

385: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
386: {
387:   unsigned int i;
388:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
389: 
390:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
391:     {
392:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
393:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
394:         {
395:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
396:           g_recovery_index = i;
397:           break;
398:         }
399:     }
400: 
401:   if (epoch == NULL)
402:     {
403:       uint32_t newest = 0;
404: 
405:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
406:         {
407:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
408:             {
409:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
410:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
411:               g_recovery_index = i;
412:             }
413:         }
414: 
415:       epoch->replay = true;
416:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
417:     }
418:   else
419:     {
420:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
421:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
422:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
423:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
424:     }
425: 
426:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
427:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
428:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
429:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
430:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
431: }

433: static void begin_abort(int result)
434: {
435:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
436: 
437:   if (g_active.busy)
438:     {
439:       g_active.quarantine = true;
440:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
441:     }
442: 
443:   if (probe != NULL)
444:     {
445:       probe->quarantine = true;
446:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
447:     }
448: 
449:   fail_pending(result);
450:   g_probe_requested = false;
451:   select_recovery_epoch();
452: }

454: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
455: {
456:   unsigned int i;
457: 
458:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
459:     {
460:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
461:         {
462:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
463:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
464:         }
465:     }
466: 
467:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
468:   return NULL;
469: }
470: 
471: static int dispatch_locked(void)
472: {
473:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
474:   struct active_transaction *active;
475:   struct logical_channel *channel;
476:   unsigned int i;
477:   int ret;
478: 
479:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
480: 
481:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
482:     {
483:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
484:         {
485:           continue;
486:         }
487: 
488:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
489:       if (ret < 0)
490:         {
491:           return ret;
492:         }
493: 
494:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
495:     }
496: 
497:   if (g_reset_pending)
498:     {
499:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
500:       if (ret < 0)
501:         {
502:           return ret;
503:         }
504: 
505:       g_reset_pending = false;
506:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
507:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
508:     }
509: 
510:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
511:     {
512:       return OK;
513:     }
514: 
515:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
516:     {
517:       channel = &g_channels[i];
518:       if (!channel->queued)
519:         {
520:           continue;
521:         }
522: 
523:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
524:         {
525:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
526:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
527:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
528:             {
529:               active = &epoch->probe;
530:             }
531:           else
532:             {
533:               continue;
534:             }
535: 
536:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
537:               !epoch->replay)
538:             {
539:               return -ENOLINK;
540:             }
541:         }
542:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
543:         {
544:           active = &g_active;
545:           if (active->quarantine)
546:             {
547:               return -ENOLINK;
548:             }
549:         }
550:       else
551:         {
552:           return OK;
553:         }
554: 
555:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
556:         {
557:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
558:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
559:                  sizeof(active->message));
560:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
561:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
562:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
563:             g_channel_ids[i]);
564:         }
565: 
566:       active->callback = channel->callback;
567:       active->arg = channel->arg;
568:       active->channel_index = i;
569:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
570:       active->busy = true;
571:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
572:       if (ret < 0)
573:         {
574:           active->busy = false;
575:           return ret;
576:         }
577: 
578:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
579:         {
580:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
581:             {
582:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
583:             }
584: 
585:           g_probe_attempts++;
586:           g_stats.probes++;
587:         }
588: 
589:       return OK;
590:     }
591: 
592:   return OK;
593: }

595: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
596:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
597:   const struct active_transaction *active)
598: {
599:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
600:   uint32_t reason = 0;
601: 
602:   if (!active->busy)
603:     {
604:       return 1u;
605:     }
606: 
607:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
608:     {
609:       reason |= 2u;
610:     }
611:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
612:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
613:     {
614:       reason |= 4u;
615:     }
616:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
617:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
618:     {
619:       reason |= 8u;
620:     }
621:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
622:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
623:     {
624:       reason |= 16u;
625:     }
626: 
627:   return reason;
628: }
629: 
630: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
631: {
632:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
633:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
634:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
635: }
636: 
637: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
638: {
639:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
640:   struct active_transaction *active;
641:   bool replay;
642:   int result;
643:   uint32_t reason;
644: 
645: 
646:   active = busy_probe();
647:   if (active == NULL)
648:     {
649:       active = &g_active;
650:     }
651: 
652:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
653:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
654:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
655:   if (reason != 0)
656:     {
657:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
658:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
659:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(0, g_stats.last_ack_header);
660:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(1, g_stats.last_active_header);
661:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
662:       return;
663:     }
664: 
665: 
666:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
667:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
668:     {
669:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
670: 
671:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
672:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
673:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
674:       return;
675:     }
676: 
677:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
678:     {
679:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
680:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
681:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(2, g_stats.bad_ack_reason);
682:       return;
683:     }
684: 
685:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
686:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
687: 
688:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
689:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
690:     {
691:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
692:     }
693: 
694:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
695:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
696:   if (replay)
697:     {
698:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
699:       unsigned int i;
700: 
701:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
702:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
703:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
704:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
705:        */
706: 
707:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
708:       g_active.quarantine = false;
709:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
710:         {
711:           if (i != replay_index)
712:             {
713:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
714:             }
715:         }
716: 
717:       select_recovery_epoch();
718:       (void)dispatch_locked();
719:       return;
720:     }
721: 
722:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
723: 
724:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
725:     {
726:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
727:         {
728:           release_recovery_slots();
729:           g_recovery_index = 0;
730:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
731:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
732:         }
733:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
734:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
735:         {
736:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
737:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
738:            */
739:         }
740:       else
741:         {
742:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
743:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
744:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
745:         }
746:     }
747: 
748:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
749:            result < 0)
750:     {
751:       begin_abort(result);
752:     }
753: 
754:   (void)dispatch_locked();
755: }

757: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
758: {
759:   struct ack_slot *slot;
760:   unsigned int rx_index;
761:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
762:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
763:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
764:   uint8_t state = 0;
765:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
766: 
767:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
768: 
769:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
770:     {
771:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
772:       if (slot == NULL)
773:         {
774:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
775:           return -EAGAIN;
776:         }
777:     }
778:   else
779:     {
780:       slot = NULL;
781:     }
782: 
783:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
784:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
785:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
786:     {
787:       g_stats.bad_header++;
788:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
789:     }
790:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
791:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
792:     {
793:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
794:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
795:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
796:         {
797:           if (slot != NULL)
798:             {
799:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
800:             }
801: 
802:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
803:           return -EAGAIN;
804:         }
805:       else if (ret < 0)
806:         {
807:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
808:         }
809:     }
810:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
811:     {
812:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
813:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
814:         {
815:           if (slot != NULL)
816:             {
817:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
818:             }
819: 
820:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
821:           return -EAGAIN;
822:         }
823:       else if (ret < 0)
824:         {
825:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
826:         }
827:     }
828:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
829:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
830:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
831:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
832:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
833:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
834:     {
835:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
836:       ack_flags = 2u;
837:       ret = OK;
838:     }
839:   else
840:     {
841:       g_stats.unsupported++;
842:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
843:     }
844: 
845:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
846:     {
847:       return OK;
848:     }
849: 
850:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
851:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
852:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
853:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
854:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
855: 
856:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
857:     {
858:       g_probe_requested = true;
859:     }
860: 
861:   (void)dispatch_locked();
862:   return OK;
863: }
864: 
865: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
866: {
867:   irqstate_t flags;
868:   uint8_t control;
869: 
870:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
871:   g_stats.rx++;
872:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
873: 
874:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
875:     {
876:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
877:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
878:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
879:         {
880:           g_stats.bad_header++;
881:         }
882:       else
883:         {
884:           g_stats.resets++;
885:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
886:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
887:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
888:         }
889:     }
890:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
891:     {
892:       handle_ack(message);
893:     }
894:   else
895:     {
896:       int ret = handle_command(message);
897: 
898:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
899:         {
900:           rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
901:           return ret;
902:         }
903:     }
904: 
905:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
906:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
907:   return OK;
908: }

910: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
911: {
912:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
913:   int ret;
914: 
915:   (void)argc;
916:   (void)argv;
917:   ret = bind_worker_to_primary();
918:   if (ret < 0)
919:     {
920:       return -EXDEV;
921:     }
922: 
923:   for (;;)
924:     {
925:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
926:       nxsem_reset(&g_diag_sem, 0);

102:   g_psram_power_waiting = true;

115:       if (ret > 0)

117:           ret = -EIO;
118:         }
119:     }
120:   else if (ret > 0)
121:     {
122:       ret = -EIO;
123:     }
124: 
125:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
126:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
127:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
128: 
129:   if (ret == OK && (g_psram_power_state != state ||
130:                     g_psram_power_result != OK ||
131:                     g_psram_power_version != PM_PSRAM_PROTO_V1))

133:       ret = g_psram_power_result < 0 ? g_psram_power_result : -EPROTO;
134:     }

290: static int pwc_rx(const void *raw)
291: {
292:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
293:   struct pwc_message message;
294:   unsigned int next;
295: 
296:   if (bytes == NULL)
297:     {
298:       return -EINVAL;
299:     }
300: 
301:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks while holding the driver lock.
302:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section instead of recursively
303:    * acquiring the non-recursive SMP spinlock here. */
304: 
305:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
306:   if (next == g_tail)
307:     {
308:       return -EAGAIN;
309:     }
310: 
311:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
312:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
313:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
314:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
315:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
316:   g_head = next;
317:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
318:   return OK;
319: }

321: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
322: {
323:   int ret = OK;
324: 
325:   (void)argc;
326:   (void)argv;
327:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_WORKER_ENTER);
328: 
329:   /* bk7258_mailbox_workers_start() pinned the bring-up thread to CPU0.
330:    * Kernel threads inherit that affinity before activation, so changing the
331:    * running PWC worker's affinity here is redundant and can trigger another
332:    * SMP scheduler transaction during the boot handshake. */
333: 
334:   g_worker_result = OK;
335:   g_worker_ready = true;
336:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_WORKER_READY);
337:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
338: 
339:   for (;;)
340:     {
341:       struct pwc_message message;
342:       irqstate_t flags;
343: 
344:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
345:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
346:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
347:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
348:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
349:       /* A full software queue leaves the physical descriptor deferred with
350:        * no transport ACK.  Freeing one entry is the progress event that must
351:        * retry that descriptor even when no new mailbox IRQ arrives. */
352: 
353:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
354:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
355:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
356:         {
357:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
358:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
359:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
360:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
361:               {
362:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
363:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
364:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
365:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
366:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
367:               }
368:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
369:             break;
370: 
371:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
372:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
373:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
374:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
375:               {
376:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
377:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
378:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
379:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
380:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
381:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
382:               }
383:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
384:             break;
385: 
386: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
387:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
388:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
389:               {
390:                 ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
391:                                     PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
392:                                     bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
393:                 if (ret != OK)
394:                   {
395:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
396:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
397:                   }
398:               }
399:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
400:               {
401:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
402: 
403:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
404:               }
405:             break;
406: 
407:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
408:             bk7258_psram_dump();
409:             break;
410: 
411:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
412:             {
413: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
414:               ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,
415:                                   PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
416:                                   (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
417: #else
418:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
419: 
420:               ret = pwc_send_wait(
421:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
422:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
423:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
424: #endif
425:               if (ret != OK)
426:                 {
427:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
428:                 }
429:             }
430:             break;
431: #endif
432: 
433:           default:
434:             break;
435:         }
436:     }
437:   return 0;
438: }

440: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
441: {
442:   int pid;
443:   int ret;
444: 
445:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_ENTER);
446:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, 0x50570001u);
447: 
448:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
449:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
450:   nxsem_init(&g_psram_power_sem, 0, 0);
451:   nxsem_init(&g_openvela_ready_sem, 0, 0);
452:   g_head = 0;
453:   g_tail = 0;
454:   g_worker_ready = false;
455:   g_worker_result = -EINPROGRESS;
456:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
457:   g_psram_power_expected_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
458:   g_psram_power_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
459:   g_psram_power_result = -EINPROGRESS;
460:   g_psram_power_version = 0;
461:   g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
462:   g_openvela_ready_received = false;
463:   g_openvela_ready_expected = 0;
464:   g_openvela_ready_echo = UINT32_MAX;
465:   g_openvela_ready_result = -EINPROGRESS;
466:   g_openvela_ready_version = 0;
467:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
468: 
469:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_CREATE_ENTER);
470:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
471:   if (pid < 0)
472:     {
473:       bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_CREATE_FAILED);
474:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, 0x5057f000u |
475:                              ((uint32_t)-pid & 0xfffu));
476:       return pid;
477:     }
478: 
479:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_CREATE_RETURN);
480:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0)
481:     {
482:       printf("PWC: worker start timeout\n");
483:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
484:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
485:     }
486:   if (g_worker_result < 0 || !g_worker_ready)
487:     {
488:       printf("PWC: worker affinity failed, error=%d\n", g_worker_result);
489:       return g_worker_result < 0 ? g_worker_result : -EIO;
490:     }
491: 
492:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_READY_WAIT_DONE);
493:   printf("PWC: worker ready\n");
494: 
495:   /* This is the core/SMP milestone.  The original HW_CTRL liveness service
496:    * is already running and the PWC worker can now service CP requests. */
497: 
498:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_BOOT_READY_SEND);
499:   ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD, 1, 0, 0);
500:   if (ret < 0)
501:     {
502:       bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, 0x5057e000u | ((uint32_t)-ret & 0xfffu));
503:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready failed, error=%d\n", ret);
504:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
505:       return ret;
506:     }
507: 
508:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_READY_SENT);
509:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, 0x50570002u);
510:   bk7258_boottrace_detail(3, 0x50570003u);
511:   printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready acknowledged by CP transport\n");
512: 
513: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
514:   ret = psram_power_set(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
515:   if (ret < 0)
516:     {
517:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
518:       if (psram_power_set(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF) < 0)
519:         {
520:           printf("PWC: PSRAM rollback response failed\n");
521:         }
522: 
523:       openvela_ready_abort(ret);
524:       return ret;
525:     }

153: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
154:                                 int result, void *arg)
155: {
156:   uint8_t command;
157:   bool failed;
158: 
159:   (void)arg;
160:   /* The mailbox transport invokes completion callbacks while holding
161:    * g_bk7258_driver_lock.  Do not reacquire the non-recursive SMP lock here.
162:    */

164:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(ack);

166:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);

170:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
171:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
172:     }
173: 
174:   if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
175:     {
176:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
177:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
178:     }
179: 
180:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
181:     {
182:       if (!failed)
183:         {
184:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
185:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
186:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
187:         }
188:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
189:         {
190:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
191:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
192:            */
193: 
194:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
195:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
196:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
197:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
198:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
199:         }
200:       else
201:         {
202:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
203:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
204:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
205:             {
206:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
207:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
208:                */
209: 
210:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
211:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
212:             }
213:           else
214:             {
215:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
216:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
217:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
218:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
219:             }
220:         }
221: 
222:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
223:     }
224:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
225:     {
226:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
227:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
228:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
229:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
230:        */
231: 
232:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
233:     }
234: 
235:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
236:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
